description: Archie Sw for 10 zones (A–J) of the hypothetical 'Rottweiler Sandstone': a = 1, m = 1.8, n = 2, Rw = 0.10 ohm·m. Compared with sw_raw (no clipping): zone I is published as 1.07 (> 1).
source: Kansas Geological Survey, PfEFFER Concepts — 'Archie Computational Equations' (kgs.ku.edu/software/PfEFFER-java/HELP/PfEFFER/Pfeffer-theory2.html), page updated July 2010
source_check: Table values read from the KGS page on 2026-10-18.
tolerance_justification: Published Sw is rounded to 0.01, so the reference is only known to ±0.005.
